visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a player's mahjong hand, showing a row of tiles held by a hand. The background shows a professional mahjong table in a brightly lit indoor studio setting. (2) The scene transitions to a top-down overhead view of the full mahjong table, where four players' positions are visible. Tiles are arranged in walls and discarded in the center. (3) A specific tile, the six bamboo, is highlighted with a digital blue circular HUD effect and a flash, drawing immediate visual attention to the play. (4) Multiple cuts show hands rapidly drawing and discarding tiles. The lighting is consistent and even, typical of a television production. (5) A player reveals their winning hand by pushing the tiles forward. The camera captures the specific combination of tiles that resulted in the win. (6) The final phase features a medium close-up of a female player with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a pearl necklace. A black-and-white filter is applied, and a digital shattered glass overlay appears over the frame for comedic effect.

(2) Distinct rhythmic clacks of mahjong tiles hit the table surface. (3) A synthesized high-pitched 'ding' sound effect coincides with the highlighting of a tile. (4) The male voice continues naming tiles sequentially: 'Er bing', 'Er tiao', 'Qi tiao' with moderate conversational speed. (5) A sharp 'impact' SFX triggers as tiles are revealed.
